name: Master
overview: The Scriptures reveal the role and responsibilities of masters, illustrating both just and unjust conduct toward servants. Abraham’s authority over his household is affirmed as one who commands his children in the way of the Lord, emphasizing justice and obedience (Genesis 18:19). Conversely, instances such as Sarai’s harsh treatment of Hagar (Genesis 16:6) and the deceit and exploitation Jacob experienced under Laban (Genesis 31:7) demonstrate the potential for mistreatment. The commands in Exodus 21:20-21 underscore the serious accountability masters have for their servants’ well-being, while the account of Joseph and his master’s wife (Genesis 39:7) highlights the complexities within master-servant relationships. Together, these passages provide a biblical framework for understanding the authority of masters balanced with the call to righteous and compassionate leadership.
